name: ibis Styles Medan Pattimura
short_description: A hotel on Jalan Pattimura adjacent to Medan's business district, with an indoor pool, DECITTA open-air bar, and an all-inclusive breakfast package.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Medan Pattimura sits on Jalan Pattimura in Medan Baru, adjacent to the city's business district and administrative offices. The hotel offers room types from Superior twins and doubles to Deluxe Suites, alongside the sTREATs all-day dining restaurant, the DECITTA open-air bar by the indoor pool, a fitness center, a kids' corner, and six meeting rooms. Guests rate the hotel solidly, with the all-inclusive package covering breakfast and internet access called a convenient value-add.

faqs.question: Is ibis Styles Medan Pattimura close to the business district?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's on Jalan Pattimura in Medan Baru, adjacent to the city's business district and administrative offices.
